newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian ATX tumbles off new life high, losses seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian ATX tumbles off new life high, losses seen.

text.p: Austrian shares closed softer after a round of profit-taking following hefty gains in early trading, which briefly pushed the blue chip ATX index to a new life high of 1,270.42 in heavy volume.
Traders were divided over the short-term outlook but most predicted a correction.
"It will depend on tomorrow. If the buyers remain in the market it will go up again," said one trader.
"The ATX could correct to 1,230 to 1,240 points," said another.
The ATX index dropped 3.27 points or 0.26 percent to 1,256.17. Among its constituents 11 shares fell, nine rose and one was unchanged.

Creditanstalt preference shares led the gainers ahead of expected news this week of an exchange offer for Creditanstalt holders by Bank Austria, which took over its competitor in January. Creditanstalt gained 5.37 percent to 483.65 schillings.
The top loser of the day was microchip maker AMS, which shed 2.28 percent to 920 schillings.
The ATX May future ended 7.1 points lower at 1,251.9. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
